cards.name: Ratcatcher Trainee // Pest Problem
cards.oracleText:
During your turn, this creature has first strike.
Create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token can't block." (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

cards.name: Probe
cards.oracleText:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Draw three cards, then discard two cards. If this spell was kicked, target player discards two cards.

cards.name: Problematic Volcano
cards.oracleText:
When Problematic Volcano enters, it deals 4 damage to any target. Then, starting with you, each player assigns their creatures to the left or right of the volcano. Creatures enter to the left or right of the volcano.
Creatures can't block creatures on the other side of the volcano.

cards.name: Probability Flux
cards.oracleText: Until your next turn, if a player would roll one or more dice, instead they roll that many dice plus one and ignore one.
